candidates.name: DOMAIN CONTAINER × EVALUATION DIMENSION = RUNTIME ADDRESS
candidates.definition: A domain container may be interrogated by reusable universal evaluation dimensions to create case/runtime addresses without declaring each instantiated address a new native primitive.
candidates.application_guard: Only instantiate combinations that are semantically meaningful; do not generate meaningless Cartesian products.

candidates.name: NO VALIDATED EVIDENCE => NO LEADING RANK
candidates.definition: When candidates are tied because no validated evidence has been entered, deterministic row order must not be presented as a leading hypothesis.
candidates.application_guard: Ranking may resume only after declared minimum evidence/coverage gates are satisfied.

candidates.name: MATCH DIRECTION / MAGNITUDE != EPISTEMIC CONFIDENCE
candidates.definition: A positive or negative fit score describes relation to a hypothesis; confidence describes evidence quality and proof status. Absolute score magnitude cannot substitute for confidence.
candidates.application_guard: Store sign/magnitude, evidence coverage, provenance and confidence separately.

candidates.name: INDEPENDENT LOOP != DUPLICATED ROUTE TEMPLATE
candidates.definition: Multiple reasoning loops count as independent only when their evidence contracts, assumptions, path dependencies or falsifiers are sufficiently independent; changing only the question over the same route is not enough.
candidates.application_guard: Measure source independence, path overlap and shared assumptions before treating multiple loop agreement as corroboration.

promotion_rule: Repeated cross-domain support plus R-F-R plus explicit review is required before any candidate becomes a native/canonical reasoning parameter or rubric.
